metadata.question: Were there more than 8 active fires in the Sakha Republic on August 6, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about active fires in Sakha Republic on August 6, 2020. I need to: 1. Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire data (FIRMS collection) 2. Define Sakha Republic geometry (I'll use a rough polygon approximation) 3. Filter for August 6, 2020 4. Count the number of active fire detections 5. Check if count > 8 For fire detection, I should use the MODIS Collection 6.1 Active Fire product (MCD14DL) or VIIRS data. Let me use MODIS as it has good historical coverage. I need to: - Define Sakha Republic polygon (approximate coordinates) - Get MODIS active fire data for August 6, 2020 - Count fire detections - Validate the count and output answer Potential issues: - No data for that date (C1) - Valid count of 0 (B) - Valid count > 8 (A) - Invalid result (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Sakha Republic approximate bounds const sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[105, 50], [165, 50], [165, 80], [105, 80], [105, 50]] ]); const date = '2020-08-06'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fires const fires = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(sakha); const fireCount = fires.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections on ${date}: ${fireCount}`); // Check for empty collection if (fireCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Count fire pixels const fireImg = fires.select('MaxFRP').mosaic(); const fireStats = fireImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = fireStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); console.log(`Active fire pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("B"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === undefined || pixelCount < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (pixelCount > 8) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
